convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Volume_Weighted_MA indicator (not a built-in MT5 indicator) and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh for money management and trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). These external dependencies must be manually replicated in Python.

other_exits: BuyPosClose/SellPosClose flags are set when opposite VWMA crossover occurs, closing opposite side positions before opening new ones

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of available margin or balance scaled by MM input (0.1 = 10%). Positive MM with non-LOT modes = deposit fraction; LOT mode = fixed lot size.

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires two conditions simultaneously: (1) VWMA[1] < VWMA[2] for long / VWMA[1] > VWMA[2] for short (MA declining/rising between bars 2 and 1), AND (2) VWMA[0] > VWMA[1] for long / VWMA[0] < VWMA[1] for short (MA turning up/down on most recent bar). This is a VWMA turning-point strategy - enter when the volume-weighted MA reverses direction. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from 1 bar ago (completed bar), not the forming bar, but Value[0] reads from offset SignalBar which is bar 1, and Value[1]=bar2, Value[2]=bar3. When SignalBar=0, the EA processes on every tick without new-bar guard. The Recount flag re-evaluates signals if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosClose/SellPosClose/SellPosOpen/BuyPosOpen input booleans act as master switches to enable/disable each trade direction and close action independently. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are computed as last bar datetime + bar period seconds, used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade timing/expiration logic.
python_conversion_notes: 1. The Volume_Weighted_MA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python using numpy/pandas - it is a volume-weighted moving average that can use tick or real volume. 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which encapsulate position checking, lot sizing based on MarginMode, order sending with deviation, and SL/TP setting - all must be reimplemented. 3. CIsNewBar class must be reimplemented for new-bar detection. 4. The GlobalVariableDel_ function cleans up global variables on deinit - can be omitted in Python. 5. LoadHistory ensures history is loaded - not needed in Python with pre-loaded data. 6. SL=1000 and TP=2000 are in POINTS not pips - no digit adjustment is performed in the EA, but the user must be aware these are raw point values (1000 points = 100 pips on 5-digit, 1000 pips on 4-digit). 7. Signal logic uses 3 consecutive VWMA values to detect turning points - ensure array indexing matches MT5's series ordering when converting to pandas.
